Scenario: Action Lock feature switched off for company
Description: When enable_action_lock is off, no status lock applies on the app even if locks are configured (AC-07).
Preconditions:
1. enable_action_lock is OFF for the company (Admin Panel)
2. Job status Completed is set to Block all in Status Settings (web)
3. Job J-10482 is Completed
4. Logged in on app as User
Steps:
1. Open the app and go to Job J-10482
2. Try Edit details, Change status and Post update
3. Check the page for a lock chip
Expected Result:
1. No lock chip is shown
2. All actions work as normal
3. The Block all setting is kept in Status Settings (not deleted)

Scenario: No status is locked by default after enabling the feature
Description: Every status starts at No lock for new and existing companies; nothing is migrated or seeded (AC-30, BR-18).
Preconditions:
1. enable_action_lock switched ON for an existing company
2. No admin has set any lock
3. Logged in on app as User
Steps:
1. Open any Customer, Project, Job and Digital Form on the app
2. Try edit, change status, post update and create actions
Expected Result:
1. No lock chip on any record
2. All actions work as before the feature was enabled

Scenario: Job in Block all status shows Locked chip and greyed controls
Description: Job whose own status is set to Block all is locked for a non-override role; controls stay visible but greyed (AC-15, FR-06).
Preconditions:
1. Job status Completed = Block all, Override = Admin only
2. Job J-10482 is Completed
3. Logged in on app as User
Steps:
1. Open Job J-10482
2. Observe the header beside Edit
3. Observe Edit, Change status, Assign, Copy, Delete, Check-in and the (+) button
4. Tap the Edit button
Expected Result:
1. 'Locked' chip shown beside Edit
2. Locked buttons are greyed, visible and keep their own icon (no lock icon on buttons)
3. (+) button is hidden because all its items are locked
4. Tapping Edit shows toast: "Locked: you can't edit details. Completed status is locked."
5. Status pill shows a lock icon

Scenario: Lock chip details panel lists locked and allowed actions
Description: Tapping the lock chip opens a panel with the reason and each action's state (FR-06, AC-02).
Preconditions:
1. Job status Completed = Block all, Override = Admin only
2. Job J-10482 is Completed
3. Logged in on app as User
Steps:
1. Open Job J-10482
2. Tap the Locked chip
3. Review the panel
4. Tap Close
Expected Result:
1. Panel shows reason "Completed status is locked." and when the lock started
2. Edit details, Change status, Assign users, Delete, Check-in, Post updates are each marked locked/allowed correctly
3. Panel closes on Close

Scenario: Post update on locked job falls back to Chat only
Description: When updates are locked, comment category is fixed to Chat with a notice (FR-04, AC-03).

1. Job status Completed = Block all
2. Job J-10482 is Completed with a To-do list
3. Logged in on app as Technician
Steps:
1. Open Job J-10482 > Updates
2. Open the comment category dropdown
3. Read the note above the comment box
4. Send a text message with a mention and a photo
5. Try to edit or delete an earlier update
Expected Result:
1. Category is fixed to Chat; other categories are hidden
2. Note says updates are closed, why, and that messages won't count toward To-do or performance
3. Message with mention and photo posts successfully in Chat
4. Earlier updates can't be edited or deleted
